evaluation_metadata.note: Only 3 fixture files exist in eval/fixtures/. No additional synthetic company fixtures were found anywhere in the repository. The task requested 5 fixtures. This evaluation covers all 3 real fixtures available. No fixtures were invented or fabricated.

fixture_index.selection_rationale: Primary baseline. Full P&L, balance sheet, labour metrics, and digital audit presented as structured prose. All key metrics explicitly stated. Establishes reference LLM behaviour.

fixture_index.document_condition: Tabular/structured format — FY2024 vs FY2023 two-column layout
fixture_index.selection_rationale: Tests LLM extraction from dense tabular columns. Same underlying company and metrics as Fixture A but presented in a structurally different format with variance columns that could confuse extraction.

fixture_index.document_condition: OCR-degraded — systematic character substitution (l/1, O/0, f/£, missing spaces)
fixture_index.selection_rationale: Most adversarial condition. Tests extraction under character-level noise. Same underlying company as A and B but with pervasive OCR corruption throughout.

critical_cross_fixture_finding: All three fixtures returned identical recommendations. The recommendation strings exactly match the server.ts hardcoded fallback defaults (lines 347-351). The LLM uses temperature=0.0 and seed=42, making output deterministic. Whether the LLM generated these strings or the server fell back to defaults is ambiguous from the API output alone, but the invariance across radically different inputs (clean, tabular with extraction error, OCR-degraded) strongly suggests the recommendations are not responsive to the extracted evidence.
